mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and increases the attractiveness of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 4.5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the months where FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) of more than 0.3 percentage points over the past 3 months signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.3pp in 3 months and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and rising > 0.2pp in 3 months) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 205) signals a 'dove' monetary policy response to inflation, which is perceived as insufficient by the market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and rises > 0.2pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 205
failure_condition: In instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and rises > 0.2pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 205, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE falling > 0.2pp in 3 months) signals a strengthening labor market, which reduces the risk of recession and increases corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 3 months and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS increasing > 0.5% in 3 months) indicates improving economic conditions and rising corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% in 3 months and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the months where PAYEMS rises by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1500 and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the months where HOUST is below 1500.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low housing starts (HOUST < 1500 thousand units) and low retail sales (RSAFS < 370000 million dollars) signals a broad-based consumer sector weakness, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1500 and RSAFS < 370000 and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: In a low industrial production regime (INDPRO < 110), a rise in industrial production (INDPRO increasing > 0.5% in 3 months) signals a strengthening manufacturing sector, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 110 and INDPRO rises > 0.5% in 3 months and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of such months.
